header.running_head: 3. The Rights and Duties of Muslims

blocks.text:
means living united with them, helping and assisting them, taking part in their affairs and giving them full attention; turning their attention towards the Deen is also part of it. One should regard their benefit as one's own benefit and their loss as a loss that has befallen oneself, help them as much as one can, and fulfil one's duties towards them.
(Ma'ariful Hadith).

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ ثَوْبَانَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: اِنَّ حَوْضِيْ مَابَيْنَ عَدَنَ اِلَي عَمَّانَ، اَكْوَابُهُ عَدَدُ النُّجُوْمِ، مَاؤُهُ اَشَدُّ بَيَاضًا مِنَ الثَّلْجِ وَاَحْلَي مِنَ الْعَسَلِ، اَوَّلُ مَنْ يَرِدُهُ فُقَرَاءُ الْمُهَاجِرِيْنَ، قُلْنَا: يَارَسُوْلَ الله! صِفْهُمْ لَنَا قَالَ: شُعْثُ الرُّؤُوْسِ، دُنْسُ الثِّيَابِ الَّذِيْنَ لَا يَنْكِحُوْنَ الْمُتَنَعِّمَاتِ، وَلَا تُفتَّحُ لَهُمُ السُّدَدُ، الَّذِيْنَ يُعْطُوْنَ مَاعَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا يُعْطَوْنَ مَالَهُمْ.
blocks.tamil_translation: When Rasulullah ﷺ said, “The size of my Hawd (pool) is equal to the distance from “Aden” to “Amman'. Its cups will be as many as the number of the stars (countless); its water will be whiter than ice and sweeter than honey. The poor Muhajirs will be the very first to come to that Hawd,” we asked, “O Rasulullah, tell us about their qualities.” He said, “They will be people with dishevelled hair, unable to marry well-off women, and wearing dirty clothes.” Doors will not be opened for them, they will not be welcomed, and even if the rights due to them are not fulfilled, they will fulfil the duties owed to others.”
